title: Truth – Righteousness
sanskrit:
सत्येनोत्तभिता भूमिः सूर्येणोत्तभिता द्यौः ।
ऋतेनादित्यास्तिष्ठन्ति दिवि सोमो अधि श्रितः ॥
meaning: By Truth the Earth is upheld; by Truth the heavens are upheld. By Yagna, the Ādityas stand firm; Soma abides in the celestial realm.
dailyApplication: Truth, righteousness, and morality are the foundation of our lives as well. Being honest even in small matters strengthens our character..

title: Everyone should walk together
sanskrit: संगच्छध्वं संवदध्वं सं वो मनांसि जानताम् ।
meaning: Move together, speak together, and let our minds be united.
dailyApplication: In a family, workplace, educational institution, or society, coordination, mutual understanding, and cooperation are essential.

title: Our thoughts should be united
sanskrit:
समानी व आकूतिः समाना हृदयानि वः ।
समानमस्तु वो मनो यथा वः सुसहासति ॥
meaning: Let your intentions be common; let your hearts be united. Let your minds be one, so that you may live together in harmony.
dailyApplication: Even when there are differences of opinion, working together harmoniously towards a common goal is very important for the family and society.

title: Good ideas should come from all directions
sanskrit: आ नो भद्राः क्रतवो यन्तु विश्वतः ।
meaning: May noble and beneficial karmas (thoughts) come to us from all sides.
dailyApplication: Rather than limiting ourselves to our own opinions, we should have an open-minded approach that welcomes good ideas from wherever they come.

title: We should see each morning as a new opportunity
sanskrit: उषो यदद्य भानुना वि द्वारावृणवो दिवः ।
meaning: O Dawn, today you open the doors of heaven with your radiant light.
dailyApplication: Every morning is a new opportunity. We should overcome our past mistakes and begin the day with renewed enthusiasm.

title: Mutual Love and Friendship
meaning: May there be harmony and unity of mind among them.
dailyApplication: In family relationships, love is more important than ego, understanding is more important than arguments, and harmony is more important than differences.

title: Pursuit of Knowledge
sanskrit: ऋचो अक्षरे परमे व्योमन् यस्मिन् देवा अधि विश्वे निषेदुः ।
meaning: These veda verses abide in the imperishable Supreme realm, in which all the divine powers are established.
dailyApplication: The Vedas teach us not merely to recite, but also to cultivate the pursuit of knowledge, deep thinking, and a strong desire to discover the truth.

title: The True Value of Sharing
sanskrit: मोघमन्नं विन्दते अप्रचेताः सत्यं ब्रवीमि वध इत् स तस्य ।
meaning: Food gained by one who does not share is gained in vain; truly, I say, it is his downfall.
dailyApplication: The true value of the wealth, knowledge, and abilities we possess comes from sharing them with others.

title: A Prayer for Universal Peace and Well-being
sanskrit:
शं नो मित्रः शं वरुणः शं नो भवत्वर्यमा ।
शं न इन्द्रो बृहस्पतिः शं नो विष्णुरुरुक्रमः ॥
meaning: May Mitra, Varuṇa, Aryamaa, Indra, Bṛuhaspati and Viṣhṇu, the wide-striding, bring us well-being.
dailyApplication: From the Vedic perspective, human life should be lived in harmony with nature, society, the divine, and all living beings.
